question:
Which term from among the given options can replace the question mark (?) in the following series to make it logically complete?

AN 37, ?, EH 50, GE 58, IB 67
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : 

 
• First letter → (2) is added to the position value according to English alphabetic series
 
• Second letter → (3) is subtracted from the position value according to English alphabetic series.
 
• Number → Consecutive number series is added to each number starting with (6).

So,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5421d01535f9aee80eed0e0f2c04dded457d756be465c0872b5957dd489fd411.png] 

​Hence, "**CK 43**" is the correct answer.
